title: Lagrange recombination coefficient
statement: Let $F$ be a field with decidable equality, let $A$ be a finite set of parties, and let $i$ be a party. The recombination coefficient of $i$ relative to $A$ is the value at $0$ of the Lagrange basis polynomial for $A$ associated to $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of parties
